execution_message.text: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one individual KCK Robot model-sheet reference, not animation or production. Image 1 is the ONLY approved identity/rendering reference (corrected Robot). Preserve Soft Handmade 2.5D: dark warm brown hand outline, cold gray lightly textured casing, blue hands and block boots, red antenna ends and cheeks, gentle upper-left light. Preserve box-shaped head with planar depth, two red-tipped antennas, long segmented limbs, outward raised arms, rectangular smiling mouth and tongue. Each visible open dark oval eye has EXACTLY ONE large white highlight at SCREEN UPPER LEFT; no lower/right highlight. Four chest controls in anatomical consistent front order: screen upper-left BLUE CIRCLE, upper-right YELLOW TRIANGLE, lower-left RED CIRCLE, lower-right GREEN RECTANGLE. Preserve proportions, limb segments and body panel geometry. One whole character, generous transparent margins, no cropping, genuine alpha, no floor/shadow/matte/text/panels/new prop or accessory. Do not change colors, shorten limbs, invent extra controls or mirror handedness. Same original pose and neutral expression except requested camera/expression. Individual square canvas with preserved proportions, no multi-view collage. View: Same three-quarter view and tilt as reference, same outward raised arms and blue boots; keep exact identity and neutral mouth.
